summary:
iter240 — STOIC main102 Review + USER REQUEST signup lock. New file backend/tests/integration/test_main102_review.py (12 tests, 12 PASSED, ~4s on live preview https://stoic-trading-bot.preview.emergentagent.com). Verified:
  • USER REQUEST signup lock — admin GET /api/admin/settings/signups returns the 6-key shape (closed/db_closed/env_closed/updated_at/updated_by/message); POST {closed:true} flips closed=true + updated_by=admin@trading.bot; public GET /api/auth/signups-status returns closed=true with the exact CLOSED_MESSAGE; POST /api/auth/register (anon, fresh email, 48-char password, terms_agreed) returns 403 with detail.code='signups_closed' kind='member' and the email does NOT create an account (re-login attempt returns 401 — the registration path short-circuits before any user doc is written); POST /api/affiliate/apply (admin session) returns 403 code='signups_closed' kind='affiliate'; existing admin login POST /api/auth/login still returns 200 while closed; POST {closed:false} reopens and public status flips back to closed=false. Audit log /api/admin/audit-log?limit=50 contains both action='signups_closed' and action='signups_opened' with actor_email=admin@trading.bot (regression on _audit() + chained append).
  • N102-1 — /api/trading/authority (user-level) release_gate domain level='FULL' in preview (account-less path returns FULL with reason 'release gate enforced in production only'); /api/admin/release-gate still returns accounts[] with required shape (regression from iter239 confirmed).
  • N102-5 — /api/ops/deploy-preflight checks[] includes id 'release_key_distinct' with status in {pass, warn} (never 'fail' in preview); 'release_signer_token_scope' still present as a separate check.
  • FRONTEND /register (anon) with signups CLOSED: data-testid='register-closed-message' + 'register-closed-login-link' rendered with the exact CLOSED message; the normal <input type=email> form is NOT shown. With signups reopened, the standard CREATE ACCOUNT form reappears (verified anonymously).
  • FRONTEND /admin/demo-readiness regression: data-testid='release-gate-accounts' present, 50 li rows with data-testid starting 'release-gate-account-' (iter239 regression holds).
  • FINAL STATE: signups are OPEN (`GET /api/auth/signups-status → {closed:false}` confirmed at report time). No test users were ever created (register was refused server-side before any user doc was persisted).

issues: The 'STOIC IS TAKING LONGER THAN USUAL' bundle-loading screen hits intermittently on /admin/users and /admin/demo-readiness (reload+retry eventually clears it, as the task note warned). Occasionally also returns a Cloudflare 'Verify you are human' challenge for first navigations to deep routes. Neither is a product bug — just note the preview reliability friction for e2e scripts.

critical_code_review_comments: backend/signup_lock.py L16-21 state() correctly surfaces env_closed OR db_closed under a single `closed` field; set_closed only updates db_closed, so an environment-level SIGNUPS_CLOSED=true cannot be overridden from the admin UI — intentional and correct (verified by test_01 shape+env_closed presence).

backend/routes/auth_routes.py L109-111 register() short-circuits with signup_lock.closed_http_exception('member') BEFORE any create_user / email verification write; test_04 confirms no account persists for the fresh email. The response shape detail={'code':'signups_closed','kind':'member','message':...} is nested under the FastAPI 'detail' envelope — frontend must unwrap r.json().detail.code (Register.jsx already does via signups-status pre-check, so register-closed renders before even POSTing).

backend/routes/admin_routes.py L222-233 admin_set_signups → audits with action='signups_closed'/'signups_opened' + target_kind='platform' / target_id='signups'; _audit() uses the chained append so admin_audit_log stays verifiable (admin_audit_verify endpoint available for operators).

backend/trading_authority.py L327-337 release_gate_domain(db, account=None) early-returns FULL with the N102-1 reason text; the previous behavior that painted demo users CLOSE_ONLY on account-less evaluation is fixed. /api/admin/release-gate still enumerates per-account allowed/reason (regression ok).
backend/deploy_preflight.py L196 release_key_distinct is present alongside release_signer_token_scope; in preview both report pass/warn (never fail). N102-5 shipped as advertised.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (register-closed card + demo-readiness regression + open->normal register verified end-to-end; the /admin/users SignupsToggle button click round-trip was blocked by the preview Vite bundle-loading / Cloudflare bot screen on the deep route — the toggle shape+code was verified by inspection and the backend contract behind it is covered by 9 of the 12 pytest tests)

test_credentials: Read from TEST_ADMIN_EMAIL/TEST_ADMIN_PASSWORD env (backend/.env preview). Never written into any file under /app. Preview admin value stored in /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: None. The one TEST_signups_<hex>@example.com register attempt was REFUSED by the server before any user doc was created (verified via a follow-up login returning 401). No TEST_ rows left behind. No admin users or affiliate rows modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_main102_review.py is self-contained: credentials from env, module-scoped autouse fixture guarantees signups are reopened at module teardown. The admin audit endpoint is /api/admin/audit-log (NOT /api/admin/audit — adjust if copying), response key is 'audit' (list of {action, actor_email, target_kind, target_id, at, ...}). For the frontend, the preview Vite dev-server intermittently shows a 'STOIC IS TAKING LONGER THAN USUAL' bundle screen on deep admin routes (/admin/users, /admin/demo-readiness) — click the RETRY button in a loop (6-10x) before giving up. Occasional Cloudflare human-check also appears for server-side (non-browser) requests on first hits; use the running browser context for all admin API toggles instead of urllib/requests directly against the preview host. Final /api/auth/signups-status at report time: {closed:false}.
rca of the issue: No product bugs observed in main102 N102 scope or in the user-requested signup lock. All backend contracts met, frontend register-closed card + admin/demo-readiness release-gate-accounts regression both verified live. The one unverified interactive step (clicking the data-testid=signups-toggle button on /admin/users) was blocked by the preview Vite loader screen; this is a known environment flake called out in the review request and does not reflect any application code issue — the backend endpoint it drives passed all 9 signup-lock tests end-to-end.
